milestone: WP-01 reusable deterministic discovery filesystem (partial WP-01)
configuration: Release C++20 strict warnings; installed SDK; Windows static CRT

sanitizers.scope: 12 simulated integration cases; all 22 core units + one fixture + test host instrumented (24 translation units); no native adapter in this focused executable

guarantees: No host filesystem I/O in simulator; path and child bindings are separate from held object ownership.
Exact native units, independent enumeration positions, live child membership, stable adapter-scoped model object IDs and observed metadata.
Per-operation failure/delay/effect/exception injection and call/resource accounting support production DirectoryListing, PaneListingJob, HeldChild and PaneModel tests.
Foreign nodes, relative binding paths and directory cycles are refused; link nodes cannot become directory cursors.
limitations: Test fixture models deterministic open-time enumeration name sequences; it does not simulate every native enumeration interleaving.
Single-owner; no filesystem case folding, normalization, native errors, provider effects or link following emulated.
Inventory/location/lookup query families remain Unsupported defaults; this does not complete full metadata or mutation simulation.
Counts bound nodes, bindings, actions and call records, not global memory; caller-supplied names/metadata remain test-controlled.
No production feature behavior, scheduler, UI, large-view index or mutation implemented in this milestone. WP-01 remains open.
validation_notes: Final 91-file source manifest verified against current source and all remote records; 33 suites / 228, 225 and 232 cases passed. Production code unchanged.

Initial CMake change regenerated projects: Mac configure/generate 3.3/0.1 seconds, Linux 2.2/0.1, Windows 14.0/1.2. Initial full build durations 5.495/5.363/24.353 seconds reflect regeneration plus one fixture compilation and executable link.

Final review hardened test checks against missing rows/observations. All three platforms recompiled the reviewed fixture and relinked core tests: Mac 2.378, Linux 2.993 and Windows 8.359 seconds. Final logs confirm intended unit and output; existing unchanged native executable required no rebuild.

Fresh diagnostic builds instrument all 24 units without reused objects. Final Mac 27.360 seconds and Windows 46.450 seconds versus preceding same-scope builds 30.066/46.454 seconds. Compiler-emitted Windows units, direct source lists/flags and hashes were inspected.

12 focused sanitizer cases passed with halt-on-error, no diagnostics; these do not qualify native adapter semantics or all Files cases. Executable hashes and zero owners recorded before diagnostic trees removed, for pre-review and final runs.
No simulator filesystem writes occur. Windows project outputs/temp stayed on V:. Both current normal build trees are retained alongside Linux normal build.
